run_metadata.coverage_summary: Network constraint unchanged from recent runs: every direct WebFetch failed at the egress proxy with DNS errors (ENOTFOUND), including not just Australian tender portals but example.com, confirming the block is global to the WebFetch tool rather than domain-specific. No tender detail page or specification document could be opened, so EVERY recorded opportunity is headline-level only (counted in entries_pending_detail). Only WebSearch (routed through Anthropic infrastructure, not the egress proxy) was available; it is US-indexed and can lag the live Australian portals. Within that limit this run was notably more productive than the last several: WebSearch surfaced reasonably current open-list snippets attributed directly to the official buyer portals. (1) Opportunity discovery: 16 buyer-originated opportunities recorded at headline level across Tier 1 (NSW buy.nsw/tenders.nsw, Buying for Victoria, Queensland eTender, Tenders SA, NT QTOL, plus the carried-over DFAT AusTender EOI) and Tier 2 local government (Sutherland Shire, Canada Bay via VendorPanel) and public health (NSW Health/HealthShare). Closing dates come from the listing snippets and still need confirmation on the live notice. (2) Source discovery: six genuinely new buyer-originated sources identified with real URLs — SA Water Supplier Portal, Sydney Water current-tenders/major-projects pipeline, WA Primary Health Alliance 'Aspire' RFQ portal, Power and Water Corporation (NT GBE) opportunities-to-tender page, Gateway by ICN (major-project work packages incl. Brisbane 2032 and BHP), and Hydro Tasmania's TenderLink e-tender box. (3) Tier 3 (mandatory) was checked — SAP Ariba / SAP Business Network Discovery, BHP (ICN Gateway + local-buy), Rio Tinto, Fortescue, Woodside, EstimateOne construction network — all registration- or invitation-gated; no publicly-visible corporate RFx was confirmed and none were fabricated.
gaps: CRITICAL: WebFetch outbound egress is fully blocked by the environment's network policy. Every attempted fetch returned a DNS failure (ENOTFOUND), including www.tenders.gov.au, www.tenders.act.gov.au and even example.com, confirming the block is global to the WebFetch tool, not domain-specific. No tender portal, detail page, or specification document could be retrieved. Same constraint as the 2026-10-05 through 2026-10-12 runs.

Detail/deliverables/requirements/evaluation-criteria/documents extraction was impossible this run (detail pages and tender documents are only reachable via WebFetch, which is blocked). All 16 recorded tenders are headline-level only; every deliverables/requirements/value/contact field left null unless published in the listing snippet.

All recorded closing dates, tender IDs and buyer attributions come from WebSearch snippets attributed to the official buyer portals (buy.nsw/tenders.nsw, tenders.vic.gov.au, etender.hpw.qld.gov.au, tenders.sa.gov.au, tendersonline.nt.gov.au, VendorPanel) and could NOT be confirmed against the live detail notice. Treat each as provisional and reconfirm on the live portal.

The initial Tenders SA query returned almost entirely South African / Canadian results (tenders.sa.gov.au did not index well); a refined query surfaced only one clearly-open SA item (DIT bituminous-works preferred supply arrangement, closing 31 Dec 2026). SA coverage this run is thin.

Western Australia (Tenders WA): no results came from the official portal; all WA leads were aggregator-sourced (govscanner, australiantenders) and mostly already closed (DFES EOIDFES250526 ~12 Oct, Main Roads EOIMRWA023325 ~13 Oct, PTA260058 ~13 Oct, DOJ202627812 ~20 Oct). Not recorded as confirmed tenders because they could not be corroborated on the buyer's own notice; WA effectively deferred this run.

Leads seen but NOT recorded because they were aggregator-only or already closed relative to the run date (2026-10-13 Sydney): George Town Council TAS cafe food EOI (closed 9 Oct); Ipswich City Council process-mapping EOI via VendorPanel (closes 13 Oct today); Sunshine Coast ITT267 (closed 8 Oct); various Helm/australiantenders QLD items (QR locomotive, QPS Wacol, ~6 Oct); NSW Health HealthShare items with conflicting aggregator dates (Blacktown retail lease 8 Oct, Ambulance income protection 30 Sep). These are discovery signals only.

Tier 3 private sector: SAP Ariba / SAP Business Network Discovery, BHP (ICN Gateway + local-buy + innovation program), Rio Tinto, Fortescue, Woodside and the EstimateOne construction network expose opportunities only behind free supplier registration or invitation; no publicly-visible corporate RFx was confirmed and none were fabricated. Invitation-only consultancy RFPs remain out of scope by definition.

Universities: no open October-2026 university RFT could be confirmed (Adelaide, ANU, Monash, Sydney, UNSW snippets were stale or closed). ANU shows '1 open tender' per a monitor with no detail. University coverage deferred.
WebSearch is US-indexed and does not reliably reflect the live state of Australian tender portals, so even the recorded results and source discovery may lag the portals.
recommended_seed_additions: Whitelist the Tier 1 tender domains (tenders.gov.au, tenders.nsw.gov.au/buy.nsw.gov.au, tenders.vic.gov.au, qtenders.hpw.qld.gov.au/etender.hpw.qld.gov.au/supply.qld.gov.au, tenders.wa.gov.au, tenders.sa.gov.au, tenders.tas.gov.au, tendersonline.nt.gov.au, tenders.act.gov.au) and vendorpanel.com.au in the environment's network egress policy — without WebFetch access the routine cannot detail or verify any tender.
SA Water — Supplier Portal: SA Water now runs its RFx through its own supplier portal (self-registration); add as the buyer-originated SA water GBE channel.
Sydney Water — Current tenders + Major Projects Pipeline (sydneywater.com.au/about-us/our-suppliers): buyer-originated NSW water GBE channel listing current open tenders and a forward pipeline.
WA Primary Health Alliance — 'Aspire' procurement portal (wapha.org.au/tender): WAPHA runs its RFQs on its own Aspire portal, separate from Tenders WA.
Power and Water Corporation (NT) — Opportunities to tender (powerwater.com.au/about/working-with-us): buyer-originated NT government-owned utility channel, separate from QTOL.

Gateway by ICN (gateway.icn.org.au): buyer-chosen capability-matching / work-package platform where major project owners (BHP Minerals Australia, Brisbane 2032 Olympic/Paralympic Games) publish EOIs; registration required.
Hydro Tasmania — TenderLink e-tender box (portal.tenderlink.com/hydro): buyer-originated use of the TenderLink platform as the GBE's own tender box (distinct from TenderLink's paid reseller product).
